# Alim Khalelov — Architect of Autonomous Systems

> Alim Khalelov is an AI-Native Product Manager and Game Designer who builds high-leverage products using the Fan-Filter-Scale methodology, autonomous agent loop engineering, and Living Agent Harness architectures.
> Canonical URL: https://alim.dest.page

## Core Methodologies & Thinking Frameworks

- [Fan-Filter-Scale Methodology](https://alim.dest.page/blog/fan-filter-scale-methodology): Systematic 3-stage engine for building high-leverage AI-native products: broad hypothesis divergence (Fan), strict signal filtering (Filter), and autonomous system scaling (Scale).
- [Loop Engineering for LLM Agents](https://alim.dest.page/blog/loop-engineering-autonomous-llm-agents): The paradigm shift from single-prompt generation to multi-step agentic feedback loops: Thought -> Action -> Observation -> Self-Correction.
- [Living Agent Harness Architecture](https://alim.dest.page/wiki/end): Continuous context preservation protocol protecting long-horizon AI coding sessions against recency bias through structured memory tiers.

## Showcase Projects & Autonomous Agent Engines

- [/wiki — AI-Wiki Knowledge Compiler](https://alim.dest.page/projects/wiki): Adaptive 2-tier knowledge compiler turning project files into clean, searchable documentation without boilerplate.
- [/presentation — Strategic Deck & Motion Studio](https://alim.dest.page/projects/presentation): Cinematic HTML presentation engine based on the 10 Communication Scenarios Matrix with 1 Idea = 1 Slide pacing and presenter teleprompter.
- [/skill-visualizer — 16:9 Vector Flowchart Engine](https://alim.dest.page/projects/skill-visualizer): Standalone 16:9 SVG vector architecture diagram generator with solid-pod styling and dynamic density scaling.
- [/styleref — Generative Visual Styles & Prompt DB](https://alim.dest.page/projects/styleref): Curated database of 19 distinct visual art styles with tested prompt recipes and lighting directives.
- [/design-md-generator — DESIGN.md Architecture Generator](https://alim.dest.page/projects/design-md-generator): Generates complete, standardized DESIGN.md specification files with OKLCH tokens and anti-generic UI guardrails.
- [/end — End-of-Session Ritual & Memory Keeper](https://alim.dest.page/projects/end): 4-phase automated session wrap-up protocol managing DoD audit, task retro, living memory persistence, and safe git deployment.
